chapter_title: The Chapter of the Three Seasons
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Three Great States

---

**¶1:** From the state when Divine wisdom proceeded forth from the Divine and was dispersed and held captive within falsity from evil, to the state when the perfected form of the Divine Human will arise and all wisdom that had been intermingled with falsity will be separated and restored to purity — from that state onward, from that first state to the state of final consummation, there are three great states of spiritual process.

**¶2:** Three states: from the state when celestial good — the primordial will created by the Divine — descended into the deepest hells, and waged the combat of temptation against the ruling love of self and all its subordinate evils and falsities. Celestial good prevailed, while the truths and goods proceeding from it remained captive among the states of evil [GAP-1] in the [GAP-2] until it would reclaim all of them [GAP-3] it constrained every power of evil, so that not one of them escaped its power. It won a great victory [GAP-4]. Celestial good endured vast successive states of spiritual progression within the state of falsity from evil, until it prevailed [GAP-5] and accomplished all that the Divine itself had ordained for it.

**¶3:** Then the Divine sent forth its proceeding spiritual truth, the source of all good. It raised celestial good up from the combat of temptation; it raised it into the state of heavenly wisdom and peace. This is the first great state: from the descent of celestial good into temptation to its liberation.

**¶4:** The second state begins from the time when celestial good ascended. The Divine proceeding as liberating truth came forth, together with the Divine Truth that receives and gives form. They arranged all things of the spiritual mind into heavenly order; they established [GAP-6] the Divine Good as source and the Divine Truth as formative principle arranged [GAP-7] all states of the spiritual mind, up to the moment when they pass outward into act [GAP-8] — this was reckoned to the second state.

**¶5:** [GAP-9] the spiritual mind [GAP-10] the Divine Rational made manifest spread forth [GAP-11] that which is within the [GAP-12] living states; it [GAP-13] separated genuine good and truth in their beautiful form from all states governed by evil and elevated them to interior and celestial states; it cast falsity and evil down into the hells, and it [GAP-14]. Now, from the moment when the Divine Rational revealed its manifest form, it purified wisdom from falsity. Evil and falsity surged upward against it. It withdrew its manifest form. Evil came [GAP-15] out of the state of falsity. It shaped false perceptions, and monstrous incomplete forms of spiritual life fell down from them. Afterward evil shaped the natural sensual human — understanding and will in their merely external state. Until the moment when Divine Truth itself was sent into the natural, and it [GAP-16] as it accomplished there the work of redemption. It gave the promise of regeneration to the natural human, and ascended to celestial states.

**¶6:** Now, from the state when the Divine Rational displayed its manifest form until the state when the perfected form of the Divine Human will arise at the consummation, shall be reckoned to the third state.

**¶8:** [GAP-17] [GAP-18] endures long in proportion to the state that celestial good endured within the realm of falsity from evil. It is a vastly greater fullness of spiritual experience than the other two states.

**¶9:** The first state, which celestial good endured within the realm of falsity from evil — how much more extensive is it than the entire duration in which this ordered spiritual mind has existed, while it stands established?

**¶10:** If you should say that [GAP-19] it is small, if you should [GAP-20] to it [GAP-21] and you inquire [GAP-22] you will answer: Twenty times greater! And it is greater still in this other measure that you will inquire of: Thirty times! Less also is this other one [GAP-23] those in spiritual states will receive the {GAP-24} of the perceptions [GAP-25] the successive states and progressions [GAP-26] from the lowest natural to the celestial. This is [GAP-27]

**¶11:** This is the third state: from the time when the Divine Rational revealed its manifest form until the perfected image of the Divine Human will arise from the mass of intermingled good and evil. This third state, in its fullness, is greater than the intermediate state; but it does not equal the fullness of the state of celestial good in temptation. For the intermediate state, in which the Divine Good and the Divine Truth constructed the ordered spiritual mind with all its degrees and arrangements, is shorter than that of celestial good in its combat.

**¶12:** Great is the state of celestial good in its primordial combat! It is more extensive than the state from when the Divine Rational displayed its manifest form through to the dissolution of the external order and the arising of the perfected Divine Human. From the state, too, when the Divine Rational displayed its manifest form through to the dissolution of the ordered spiritual mind [GAP-28] when the Divine Good and the Divine Truth shaped the spiritual mind into its forms.

**¶13:** These are the [GAP-29] three great states of spiritual process that unfold within the work of redemption and regeneration.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: From the time when the Light came forth and was crucified in the Darkness, to the season when the Statue will ascend and the entire Light, which was conjoined with the Darkness, will be purified and cleansed. From that time on, from that time to the season of the end totals three seasons.

Three seasons: from the time when the First Man went down to the abyss, and waged the war and the struggle against the King of the realms of Darkness and his other powers. He was victorious, while his sons remain behind with them in the worlds [of darkness. He persevered] in the [war] until he shall catch all of them [and] he bound them all up, so that not one of them escaped his hand. He won a great victory [over all the powers of Darkness] The First Man spent human lifetimes and generations in the land of darkness, until he prevailed [and] he fulfilled the will of the greatness that was commanded of him.

Then they sent the Living Spirit, the Father of Life. He brought the First Man up from the struggle, he brought him up to the land of light. This is the first period, from the descent of the First Man to his ascent.

The second season is from the time when the First Man ascended. The Living Spirit came, and the Mother of Life. They set in order the things of the universe, they set up [the world] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living set in order [the things of] the universe, up to the moment when they go out [from the world] it was reckoned to the second season.

[And when] the universe [had been set in order] the Third Ambassador spread [his image upon all] that is in the [land of the] living; he [purified and] he separated beauty from all the powers and scooped it up to the heights, he swept the waste to the abyss, and he [cleansed the light from the darkness] Now, from the moment when the Ambassador revealed his image he purified the light. Sin spurted up towards him. He hid his image. Sin came [down] from the Darkness. It sculpted the trees and the abortions fell down. Afterwards they sculpted Adam and Eve in the flesh. Until the moment when Jesus was sent and he [appeared] as he performed there his will. He gave the hope to Adam, and ascended to the heights.
Now, from the time when the Ambassador displayed his image until the season when the Statue will ascend at the end, shall be reckoned to the third season.
[Now] [the first season] lasts long in the time that the First Man spent in the world of Darkness. It is a very great count of time, more than the (other) two seasons!
The first season, which the First Man spent in the world of Darkness, is how much longer than the time that this universe has been? While it is established?

If you should say that [it is ten times] it is small, if you should [add to it and say it] to him [again] and you consult [him] you will tell him: Twenty times! It is greater again in this other one that you will consult: Thirty times! Less also is this other one [that you will reckon. And] people will receive the [fruit] of the trees [and they will reckon] the years and the generations [from the] earth to the heights. This is [the count]

This is the third period, from the time when the Ambassador revealed his image until the Statue will ascend from the lump. It again, that time, is greater than the intermediate; but it does not come equal to the time of the First Man. For this intermediate season, in which the Father of Life and the Mother of Life constructed the universe with its orders, is shorter than that of the First Man.

Great is the period of the First Man! It lasts longer than the season in which the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the world and the Statue ascends. From the time too when the Ambassador displayed his image, until the dissolution of the universe [is greater than the time] when the Father of Life and the Mother of Life shaped the universe.
These are the [great] three periods of time that occur.

fills.explanation: The sons (light elements) remain captive in the worlds of darkness while the First Man continued his combat; the spiritual reading confirms the sons "remained captive among the states of evil" and the subject then shifts to the First Man's ongoing struggle.
The First Man persevered "in the war" until reclaiming his sons, echoing the earlier phrase "waged the war and the struggle" and corresponding to the state of temptation-combat.
A simple connective joining "catch all of them" to "he bound them all up," as confirmed by the spiritual reading's parallel "reclaim all of them... constrained every power."

fills.fill: over all the powers of Darkness
fills.explanation: The victory is naturally over the adversary powers already named ("the King of the realms of Darkness and his other powers"), and the spiritual reading confirms victory over all states governed by evil.
A connective joining "he prevailed" to "he fulfilled the will of the greatness," as confirmed by the spiritual reading's "prevailed and accomplished all."

The Living Spirit and Mother of Life "set up the world" as the macrocosmic structure; the spiritual reading confirms they "established" something before the Father/Mother of Life then arranged the universe in detail.
Parallels the earlier phrase "set in order the things of the universe" in the same paragraph, and the spiritual reading confirms they "arranged all states of the spiritual mind."

The Father of Life and Mother of Life complete their ordering and "go out from the world" — their departure from the ordered cosmos marks the boundary of the second season, consistent with the spiritual reading's "pass outward into act."
A temporal transition introducing the third season's events; the paragraph describes the Ambassador's work after the universe was ordered, requiring a temporal conjunction.

The second season's ordering must be complete before the third season begins; "when the universe had been set in order, the Third Ambassador spread..." establishes the precondition for the Ambassador's work.

The Third Ambassador "spread his image" as the act of manifestation; later in the paragraph "the Ambassador revealed his image" confirms "image" as the key term, and "upon all" connects to "that is in the land of the living."
The phrase "land of the living" is a standard ancient cosmological expression for the realm of light, and the spiritual reading's "living states" confirms the referent.

The Kephalaia frequently employs paired verbs; "he purified and he separated beauty" describes the Ambassador's twofold action, consistent with the spiritual reading's emphasis on separating genuine good and truth.

fills.fill: cleansed the light from the darkness
fills.explanation: This summarizes the Ambassador's threefold cosmological work: beauty elevated to the heights, waste swept to the abyss, and the light cleansed from the darkness — completing the purification triad before the mythological narrative restarts.

After sin "spurted up" and was rejected when the Ambassador hid his image, sin then came "down" from the Darkness to the material realm where it sculpted trees and abortions — the directional reversal completes the narrative sequence.

Jesus "appeared" parallels the Ambassador "revealing his image" earlier in the paragraph; the spiritual reading confirms Divine Truth was manifested in the natural, and "appeared" captures this theophanic sense.
The Kephalaia characteristically introduces new expository points with "Now" (Coptic ⲧⲉⲛⲟⲩ), transitioning from the enumeration of three seasons to a comparison of their durations.

The subject of "lasts long" must be the first season, since the paragraph goes on to say it exceeds the other two seasons — confirmed by the spiritual reading's reference to the state of celestial good in temptation.

The passage employs an escalating pattern of numerical multiples (then 20×, then 30×); the first estimate must be 10×, which is then declared "small" (insufficient), establishing the tenfold escalation pattern.

fills.fill: add to it and say it
fills.explanation: In the didactic escalation pattern, the student is told to increase ("add to") the estimate and present it to the interlocutor, yielding the higher answer of Twenty times.
The passage describes a pattern of escalating consultations (10×, then 20×, then 30×); "again" marks the repeated inquiry, consistent with the spiritual reading's pattern of successive inquiries.
The interlocutor addressed as "him" in "to him" is the same person being consulted; "you consult him, you will tell him: Twenty times!" completes the didactic exchange naturally.

Continues the pattern of insufficient estimates ("this other one that you will reckon" is still too small), then transitions with "And" to the new method of true reckoning through wisdom (fruit of the trees).

The most natural collocation with "of the trees" is "fruit"; in correspondence, fruit represents the product of perception (trees), consistent with the spiritual reading's "receive the {GAP-24} of the perceptions."

People receive the fruit (wisdom) of the trees (perceptions), and through this wisdom they will reckon the years and generations — connecting the reception of knowledge to the measurement of cosmic time.
The spiritual reading specifies "from the lowest natural to the celestial," which in the text's register is "from the earth to the heights" — the gap supplies the preposition and article.
Echoes ¶8's "a very great count of time" and concludes the measurement discussion; "This is the count" summarizes the reckoning of the first season's duration.

Paragraph 11 already establishes that the third season "is greater than the intermediate"; GAP-28 restates this comparison — the time from the Ambassador to dissolution exceeds the time when Father/Mother of Life shaped the universe.
The spiritual reading specifies "three great states of spiritual process"; the chapter emphasizes the vastness of these periods, and "great" is the standard Kephalaia intensifier for cosmic epochs.
